Companion Animal Travel Desk Policy
This section sets out the handling standards that protect travelers and animals with care and consistency.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk will give every animal patient attention from trained staff, and the senior coordinator will oversee daily service decisions so that requests are handled fairly and promptly. When a traveler such as Ben Ibrahim, Nikhil Nakamura, or another guest presents a companion animal, staff will review the booking details, confirm the service needs, and record any change in the desk ledger without delay. If a rabbit is presented, <<FACT F064>> Staff will not make exceptions that reduce comfort, safety, or humane treatment, and they will speak with courtesy at all stages of the visit.

The desk will accept updates to travel arrangements only when the traveler has provided the required details and the animal can be safely accommodated within current service limits. Staff will explain any restriction in calm, direct language and will guide the traveler toward the next available option whenever a request cannot be completed as given. Handling must remain steady, quiet, and respectful, and any concern about the animal's condition must be referred at once to the senior coordinator.

All notes entered in the desk ledger must be clear, complete, and factual, with no casual wording or personal opinion. Any service change, special handling request, or refusal must be documented before the traveler leaves the counter. This record is part of the desk's duty to maintain continuity and protect the animal's welfare.

For questions about this section, contact the senior coordinator at the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
